rules.text: Creatures have no eyes (the Mew is waiting on the owner).
Statues and sculptures are faceless or veiled.
Cross shapes become stars (finials, windows, decorations).
Every outfit is modest; hijab-friendly headwear exists.
Women's party dresses are visible only to female accounts.
Combat is magical: enemies shatter into light and petals, no blood.
Meshy models keep their natural size; only the palace is enlarged (x2.75).
Only the owner is the Mew; it is not in the pet menu and its voice is hidden until the reveal.
Creatures are original designs inspired by Pokemon, cartoons and myth, not copies.

characters.name: Palace Steward
lines: You brought the light all the way home. Look up.

dialogue.plea: The Hush is in the heart of the palace. Bring every shard home.
dialogue.freed: You brought the light all the way home. Look up.
dialogue.farewell: Midnight is almost here. Go stand where the roof will open.

characters.name: Lady of Tides
lines: The lake remembers your laugh now. It will sing it back to you.

dialogue.plea: Moonlight still answers you. Catch it for me.
dialogue.freed: The lake remembers your laugh now. It will sing it back to you.
dialogue.farewell: We will sail the lanterns to the palace for your midnight.

characters.name: Bell Warden
lines: Listen. Every bell is ringing your name.

dialogue.plea: The rose window is dark. Only star beams can wake it.
dialogue.freed: Listen. Every bell is ringing your name.
dialogue.farewell: We will ring you in at midnight, all of us at once.

characters.name: Knight of Roses
lines: Rise, friends of the Rose Keep. You fought like a story.

dialogue.plea: The thorns are around my heart. Cut them away, friends.
dialogue.freed: Rise, friends of the Rose Keep. You fought like a story.
dialogue.farewell: The knights will ride ahead and keep the road clear for you.

characters.name: Mist Sage
lines: The mist has lifted, and the mountain can see you.

dialogue.plea: Bring the little light through the fog. Do not let it go out.
dialogue.freed: The mist has lifted, and the mountain can see you.
dialogue.farewell: We will bring the clear sky with us to the palace.

characters.name: Lantern Master
lines: Look how the sky fills. Every lantern carries a wish for you.

dialogue.plea: Paint them again. Colour is stronger than shadow.
dialogue.freed: Look how the sky fills. Every lantern carries a wish for you.
dialogue.farewell: Our lanterns will float above the palace at midnight.

characters.name: Keeper of Echoes
lines: The echoes are back, and the loudest one says happy birthday.

dialogue.plea: Only someone who truly knows her can answer. Who knows her best?
dialogue.freed: The echoes are back, and the loudest one says happy birthday.
dialogue.farewell: We will carry your echoes to the theatre tonight.

characters.name: Arena Champion
lines: Never has the arena seen such a team. The crowd is yours.

dialogue.plea: The Shadow Champion wears my armour. Defeat it and set me free.
dialogue.freed: Never has the arena seen such a team. The crowd is yours.
dialogue.farewell: Every champion will stand guard at your celebration.

characters.name: Canal Mayor
lines: Every villa has its invitation. The whole city is coming.

dialogue.plea: The canals are still. Make the city move again.
dialogue.freed: Every villa has its invitation. The whole city is coming.
dialogue.farewell: The gondolas will bring the whole city to the palace.

characters.name: Sun Queen
lines: The canyon is singing with water again. The sun is pleased.

dialogue.plea: Turn the waters back to the canyon. It remembers the way.
dialogue.freed: The canyon is singing with water again. The sun is pleased.
dialogue.farewell: We will bring the warmth of the canyon to your night.

characters.name: Arch Guardian
lines: The giant is smiling again. So is the sea.

dialogue.plea: The stone giant was our friend. Wake the friend inside it.
dialogue.freed: The giant is smiling again. So is the sea.
dialogue.farewell: The giant will carry us to the palace on its shoulders.

characters.name: Baker of Stories
lines: Smell that? That is the best cake layer ever baked.

dialogue.plea: One layer from every land. Bake it together and it cannot crack.
dialogue.freed: Smell that? That is the best cake layer ever baked.
dialogue.farewell: This layer goes straight to the palace. Do not peek.

characters.name: Miller of Winds
lines: Hear the sails creak? That is the windmill laughing.

dialogue.plea: Turn the great sails together, all in time.
dialogue.freed: Hear the sails creak? That is the windmill laughing.
dialogue.farewell: We will send the good wind ahead to carry you home.

characters.name: Sky Architect
lines: You built something that will outlast us all.

dialogue.plea: Build the bridge together. Every plank holds the next.
dialogue.freed: You built something that will outlast us all.
dialogue.farewell: We will string bridges of light to the palace.

characters.name: Vine Oracle
lines: The jungle breathes again. Listen to the frogs sing.

dialogue.plea: The vines obey those who trust each other.
dialogue.freed: The jungle breathes again. Listen to the frogs sing.
dialogue.farewell: The jungle will bloom along your road home.

characters.name: Fjord Chieftess
lines: The fjord is free and the whales are coming home.

dialogue.plea: Its heart is not ice. Find the warmth in it.
dialogue.freed: The fjord is free and the whales are coming home.
dialogue.farewell: Our longboats will row the ice lanterns to your midnight.

characters.name: Forest Spirit
lines: The fireflies remember you now. They will follow you anywhere.

dialogue.plea: Gather the fireflies. Hold the ruin until the dawn of colour.
dialogue.freed: The fireflies remember you now. They will follow you anywhere.
dialogue.farewell: We will light the path to the palace with fireflies.

characters.name: The Mother Tree
lines: I have stood for a thousand years, and I have never felt so loved.

dialogue.plea: Bring the water spirits to my roots, little ones.
dialogue.freed: I have stood for a thousand years, and I have never felt so loved.
dialogue.farewell: My blossoms will rain on your celebration.

characters.name: Harbour Master
lines: The harbour sparkles again. The otters want to hold your hand.

dialogue.plea: Sail out and win back the harbour lights.
dialogue.freed: The harbour sparkles again. The otters want to hold your hand.
dialogue.farewell: Every boat in the cove will sail to the palace tonight.

characters.name: Bridge Keeper
lines: There. The water is dancing for you again.

dialogue.plea: Dance across the bridge. Wake the ripples.
dialogue.freed: There. The water is dancing for you again.
dialogue.farewell: The bridge will light the way back to the palace.

characters.name: Star Astronomer
lines: Now the sky has a map, and every star on it leads to you.

dialogue.plea: Line up the lenses. The stars will point the way.
dialogue.freed: Now the sky has a map, and every star on it leads to you.
dialogue.farewell: We will chart the midnight sky for your celebration.

characters.name: Light Keeper
lines: The lighthouse shines again, brighter than it ever has.

dialogue.plea: Guide them through the storm. Be the light.
dialogue.freed: The lighthouse shines again, brighter than it ever has.
dialogue.farewell: Our beam will cross the sky at midnight. Look for it.

characters.name: Pearl Diver
lines: A string of pearls, one for every friend who dived.

dialogue.plea: Dive deep. The pearls rise for laughter.
dialogue.freed: A string of pearls, one for every friend who dived.
dialogue.farewell: These pearls will shine at your midnight table.

characters.name: Coral Priestess
lines: The reef glows again, and the Leviathan sings to you.

dialogue.plea: The Leviathan is in pain. Purify it and it will remember us.
dialogue.freed: The reef glows again, and the Leviathan sings to you.
dialogue.farewell: The sea will come to the palace to watch your night.

characters.name: Gardener of Glass
lines: Choose any flower you like. They all grew for you.

dialogue.plea: Light makes glass bloom. Shine on my garden.
dialogue.freed: Choose any flower you like. They all grew for you.
dialogue.farewell: The finest bouquet will wait for you at midnight.

characters.name: Elder Dragon
lines: Dragons never forget a friend, and now you have a hundred.

dialogue.plea: Ride the young dragons. Show the old one what joy looks like.
dialogue.freed: Dragons never forget a friend, and now you have a hundred.
dialogue.farewell: At midnight, the dragons will paint the sky with fire for you.

characters.name: Oasis Keeper
lines: The oasis flows again. Drink, rest, and take a lantern of sand.

dialogue.plea: Only true friends can see the real water. Find it together.
dialogue.freed: The oasis flows again. Drink, rest, and take a lantern of sand.
dialogue.farewell: The desert will send its warmest stars to your celebration.

characters.name: Snow Weaver
lines: The ice is clear as glass now, and it holds your reflection.

dialogue.plea: Carve something beautiful together, and the frost will let go.
dialogue.freed: The ice is clear as glass now, and it holds your reflection.
dialogue.farewell: We will carve the cake stand for your midnight.

characters.name: Crystal Miner
lines: The caverns are glowing again. Take the brightest crystal.

dialogue.plea: Find the true echo, and the crystals will sing it back.
dialogue.freed: The caverns are glowing again. Take the brightest crystal.
dialogue.farewell: Our crystals will light the theatre at midnight.

characters.name: Cloud Shepherd
lines: The whole sky is singing. The whales will never forget you.

dialogue.plea: Guide the little ones home. They will follow kind voices.
dialogue.freed: The whole sky is singing. The whales will never forget you.
dialogue.farewell: The sky whales will swim over the palace at midnight.

characters.name: Meadow Queen
lines: Every flower here is a little brighter because of you.

dialogue.plea: Paint the field, and the flowers will wake.
dialogue.freed: Every flower here is a little brighter because of you.
dialogue.farewell: The meadow will send a flower crown for your midnight.

characters.name: Ringmaster
lines: Ladies and gentlemen, the champions of the fair!

dialogue.plea: Win the finals, and the fair will shine again.
dialogue.freed: Ladies and gentlemen, the champions of the fair!
dialogue.farewell: The whole fair will march to the palace with music.

story.macguffin: The Great Birthday Lantern, cracked into 32 star shards

acts.name: The ladies arrive
acts.summary: Female friends ride in through the waterfall gate, cross the bridge, explore the palace and dress up.

acts.name: Her surprise
acts.summary: She opens her link, rides in with the full aerial reveal, is welcomed with confetti, and the Mew bonds with her.

acts.name: The Hush falls
acts.summary: The men arrive by flying ship; the Hush cracks the lantern into 32 shards and greys the land.

acts.name: The 32 places
acts.summary: Free each head, befriend creatures, play the game, beat the challenge, win the shard; saved people go to the palace.

acts.name: Midnight
acts.summary: Final boss, then the roof opens, the floating theatre forms, the cake, and the Mew becomes the owner.

cinema.look: Letterbox bars slide in (2.35:1), shallow depth of field, a warm grade, and soft film grain. Every scene is a live camera in the game world, never a video.
cinema.sync: The host starts a scene for everyone at the same moment (net message "cutscene" with id, place and start time), so all friends see it together.
cinema.players: Friends stand on marks around the subject; first-person players see the camera cut. Their pets and the Mew stay in frame.
cinema.voices: Characters speak in soft musical babble with subtitles, each with their own pitch. The Mew only mews. No voice acting needed.
cinema.skip: A reusable scene plays in full the first time and in its short version after that. Unique scenes can be skipped only by majority vote, except the finale.
cinema.pacing: A full place visit has about 90 seconds of scenes inside roughly 10 minutes of play, so the story never stalls the fun.
